description: Returns the payment terms for https://horizonpulse.dev/api/sec/earnings-calendar (base $0.005; USDC on Base only); this tool never runs the check or pays. Pay the 402 over HTTP with x402 v2: GET ?ticker=CSCO (or cik; optional forms, items=2.02, limit, from, to). Earnings release history for a company: filed 8-K reports listing Item 2.02 only (Results of Operations and Financial Condition), newest first, with filing date, report date, items, accession and link. Filed history only, not a calendar. Results filed only in a 10-Q, 10-K or 6-K are not listed. Bad input or no matching filings: not charged. USDC on Base only. Data from SEC EDGAR; not affiliated with or endorsed by the SEC. Not investment advice.
